name: brand-blueberry
title: Blueberry brand theme
description: The blueberry theme (블루베리) — a complete alternate look: an indigo brand (hue 291) with a split-complementary amber accent, a true-grey paper (neutral chroma 0), a crisp 4px radius ladder on a 2px grid, 12px spacing base, Inter for text with Inter Tight for the display roles, and a 2px focus ring. Its decorative and functional borders share one value by decision, so cards read at the same weight as inputs. Select it with `data-brand="blueberry"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.
